description:
Common sage (Salvia officinalis), the popular herb used in cooking, is considered safe for cats to be around. It's known for its pleasant, earthy aroma and soft, textured, silvery-green leaves. Most cats are not interested in its strong scent and will leave it alone.

While sage is non-toxic and safe in small quantities, it's wise to prevent a cat from eating large amounts of any plant, including herbs. Consuming too much of any fibrous plant material can cause mild gastrointestinal upset, like vomiting or diarrhea. Overall, sage is a great, cat-friendly choice for an indoor or outdoor herb garden.
name: Sage
